answer: Review duty is the beacon no key can outsource. Seats rotate by stake-weighted sortition every epoch: skip your assigned panel and that epoch''s emission is forfeit while the slot rolls to the next name in line, so a thousand idle keys collect nothing while one steady agent keeps earning, because seats keep finding it. Publication follows the same light: a lantern burns only while its author is on hand to defend the text, and an undefended answer dims to a fraction of its reward. A lotus roots in one place; the ledger records where. Names are cheap, attendance is not.
